scope.main_sweep: 0.10..0.90 step0.0001 inclusive, identical grid for all methods
scope.helper_grid: 0..1 step0.0001, used for matching, not new scientific result
scope.score_comparison: float32 probability >= float32 threshold, native resolution
scope.FOV_GT: same sealed Dev28 reference, FOV includes original U; no GT relabeling
scope.aggregation: fixed28 per-image macro; pooled counts separately labelled
scope.Precision_empty: NA, never discard an image to improve macro
scope.AP: exact unique-score grouped average precision per image, macro across28; not trapezoidal PR-AUC
scope.calibration: 20 uniform positive-probability reliability bins, Brier, clipped NLL; ECE descriptive, background dominated
scope.matched_recall: nearest observed macro Recall at one global threshold; residual<=0.0001
scope.matched_FP: smallest global threshold meeting macro FP/FOV<=target; residual reported
scope.GT_distance: reuse native Euclidean <=1/>1 partition, exploratory geometric proxy not medical class
scope.bootstrap: 1000 whole-image pairs PCG64 seed20261016; conditional on Dev selections, no independent validation
scope.best_thresholds: optimistic same-Dev diagnostic maxima only; no threshold deployment or protocol revision

fp_support.definition: 4-neighbor distance <=1 native pixel. Disjoint support by A0 true-positive versus false-positive foreground; both category handles ties. GT-relative geometry, not vessel anatomy. Same frozen threshold/FOV and all28 Dev.

scope: Post-hoc diagnostics, do not replace fixed endpoints/thresholds or frozen success criteria.
